summary: Medicure Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting financial results for the year ended December 31, 2025, and announcing a conference call on April 27, 2026. The release discusses revenue growth, including recent pharmacy acquisitions, a net loss driven by a CMS rebate liability and R&D spending, but no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review. The filing is a routine earnings report with a scheduled investor call, not a triggering corporate transaction. As a foreign private issuer using Form 6-K, this is the equivalent of a U.S. earnings press release.
